overview.description: The Nuveen Impact Bond ETF (NUIB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fixed income ETF that seeks total return by investing in use-of-proceeds securities that finance direct, measurable environmental and social outcomes. The strategy utilizes proprietary credit analysis to pursue both alpha generation and meaningful real-world impact. NUIB was launched on Sep 14, 2026 and is issued by Nuveen.
